facts.text: Jolene experienced a sense of peace and gratitude while doing yoga at a waterfall oasis with her partner.

evidence.quote: I remember taking a hike with my partner and coming across a waterfall oasis. Everything just felt so peaceful and my worries just disappeared. It was such a refreshing experience.
It was amazing! Doing yoga with that backdrop made me feel connected to nature and myself. I felt incredibly peaceful and thankful.

facts.text: Jolene plans to reconnect with nature by going out in nature again next month.

evidence.quote: Yeah! I'm planning to get out in nature again next month. It's going to be great reconnecting with it!

facts.text: Deborah mentioned a blossom tree near her home that blooms every spring and was magical to watch.

evidence.quote: This photo made me think of a gorgeous blossom tree from near my home. Every spring, it was magical to watch it bloom.
